notes.title: New title: "Abnormal1999:Apartment of Death"
notes.notes:
Hello there,
To better reflect the series, we've updated the game title to include "Abnormal1999".

The new title is "Abnormal1999:Apartment of Death".

Rest assured, the game's core experience remains unchanged. We hope you'll continue to enjoy the Abnormal1999 universe.

The series includes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2817190/]《Abnormal1999:With in the Obscurity》[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2862730/]《Abnormal1999:Apartment of Death》[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925090/]《Abnormal1999:SU - Unlocking the 4th Dimension》[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2990560/]《Abnormal1999:Hyperspace》[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3057180/]《Abnormal1999:49 Sector》[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146640/]《Abnormal1999:The Compass and the Sand》[/url]

Abnormal1999:The Compass and the Sand will be released on September 9th. Add it to your wishlist now!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
First off, thank you to all players for your support. The first version revealed a few issues, which I have addressed. Here are the specifics:

Fixed the signage issue in the prison room.
The killer will no longer pursue you at the start of a new game unless triggered.
Fixed a bug in Huang Lingling's room.
Just a friendly reminder to all players: if you wish to solve the puzzles peacefully, try to avoid triggering the killer.

notes.title: Room 110: The Abattoir
notes.notes:
In this developer log, I'm excited to showcase the latest progress on my upcoming horror game, "Death Apartment." Today, we're taking a closer look at Room 110, a terrifying location that players will encounter after being killed by the game's antagonist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916983/d987254947e64bfa293fdf17de2541f53c7b6988.png[/img]

Room 110:

A ghastly chamber where players will respawn after being killed by the killer.
Players must navigate through a pile of dead bodies to return to the living.
Dubbed the "Abattoir," this room serves as a grim testament to the killer's brutality.
Inspired by a nightmare I had, the visuals are intentionally unsettling and disturbing.
Conclusion:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916983/5725adca68bd40189a9d9d354773cbbf91ab472a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44916983/8b3718c5806843e3ef1e3f78efac63b8fccee739.png[/img]

I hope you enjoyed this glimpse into Room 110. I'm thrilled to continue sharing more details about "Apartment of Death" in the coming weeks. Stay tuned for more updates!
